tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
A family is suing OpenAI, claiming ChatGPT played a role in their daughter's death. Reported by KOMO.
Anthropic's IPO filing highlights China artificial intelligence rivalry, with model distillation and chip export controls emerging as key risks. Reported by digitimes.
The US Department of Justice has flagged competition risks in Nvidia's acquisition of open-source artificial intelligence platform Hugging Face. Reported by Firstpost.
A Seattle woman reduced her epilepsy medication dose following ChatGPT's advice, risking unsafe self-medication. Confirmed by The Seattle Times.
Goodwin has launched an artificial intelligence Governance Benchmark in Claude for Legal, helping legal teams assess artificial intelligence oversight. Reported by citybiz.
Free every hour.
